column1: # ai-agent-config manifest: one deployed artifact per line (tab separated).
#   id            unique name (also the backup/state key)
#   mode          copy | seed | link | copydir | merge-hooks | merge-agy-hooks | merge-agy-skills | merge-muse-context | merge-enforce | merge-union | merge-codex-persona | shims
#   src           copy/seed/copydir: path relative to ai-agent-config/
#                 link: the *target* the symlink points to | merge-*: JSON fragment | shims: -
#   dest          where it lives on this Mac (~ allowed)
#   cond          always | cmd:<binary>  (deployed only when that CLI is installed)
#   flags         optional. `protect` = a deployed instruction file: agents may not edit it directly
#                 (the gate refuses; install.sh writes the list to ~/.agent-state/protected-paths.txt)
#   copy     live file is a working copy of src; install refuses to overwrite live edits
#   seed     placed only when absent; afterwards live owns it (the registry is auto-refreshed)
#   link     dest is a symlink to src
#   merge-hooks          our hook entries are merged into a JSON file with a `hooks` object
#                        everything else in the file is left untouched
#   merge-agy-hooks      our named hook set ("ai-agent-config") in agy's hooks.json
#   merge-muse-context   turns off Muse's automatic import of other agents' personal rules/skills
#   merge-codex-persona  Codex's persona goes into config.toml `developer_instructions` (a managed
#                        block); the shared rules reach Codex through the AGENTS.md symlink
#   merge-union          the fragment's values are added to what the file already has (arrays are
#                        unioned, so entries the user added stay); rollback removes only ours
#   merge-enforce        the fragment's JSON keys are forced to the repo's values on every install
#                        (a value changed by hand is reset); keys the fragment does not mention
#   shims    one-version compatibility shims at the old ~/.claude/hooks/delegation/ paths
# Nothing not listed here is managed.
